name: Kinshicho
tagline: Tokyo in 9 minutes and Otemachi in 14 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Sumida City, where JR East and Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 14 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 33 minutes to Shibuya and 23 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 5.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 5.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.5 m to 5.5 m, a difference of 6.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 8 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 8 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 19 clinics and 11 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 都立墨東病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 賛育会病院, about 11 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) run through it. JR Sobu Main Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 2 lines and Tokyo Metro runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Sobu Main Line runs at 160% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 新小岩→錦糸町, which includes this station. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 錦糸町→両国, which includes this station. Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line runs at 111% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 渋谷→表参道, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Kinshicho is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Kinshicho.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Kameido, but Kinshicho is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: About 1 km away in a straight line. It takes 7 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Kinshicho. One-room rents run about ¥13,000 lower.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
noiseSources: 四ツ目通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
京葉道路;錦糸町駅前 (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 17 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The number of points that fall inside the projected inundation area is about average for a station in the 23 wards.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
